status: prospective GPU systems protocol locked before verification-aware async GPU outcomes
purpose: measure when asynchronous rollout outruns verification and whether bounded verification-aware admission controls debt without silently corrupting learner provenance
claim_boundary: systems phase diagram for this pinned model/task/hardware configuration; no universal throughput or safety claim

sync_inline.description: generation waits for group verification before the next rollout group

async_policy_only.description: generation and verification are decoupled; only behavior-policy lag bounds learner admission

verification_aware_async.description: decoupled generation/verifier/learner with independent policy/verifier freshness and verification-debt backpressure

failure_injection: terminate verifier worker with an in-flight verification lease and restart the driver
inject verifier exceptions until bounded quarantine activates
refresh the learned verifier while ready replay exists and require stale rewards to re-enter pending verification
hard_invariants: pending_verification and verifying groups are never learner-consumed
one replay group never mixes verifier versions
behavior tokens and behavior logprobs are unchanged by verification or reverification
policy lag and verifier lag learner admission bounds are mechanically enforced
restart recovery does not duplicate learner consumption
verifier exceptions are not converted into zero-reward training examples

interpretation.primary_systems_question: Does verification-aware admission bound verification debt and reward staleness under slow verification while retaining useful learner throughput?
interpretation.quality_rule: No quality/stability superiority claim without heldout trusted evaluation.
interpretation.negative_results: Retain throughput regressions, null quality effects, underpowered runs, failures, and quarantined work.
